answer: A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The prism counter is kept in umber and river exposes each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 9 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
